name: Oreb
bio: Oreb was a leader of Midian. After Gideon's three hundred men routed the Midianite camp by night, Gideon summoned the Ephraimites to cut off the fleeing enemy at the fords of the Jordan. The Ephraimites captured the two Midianite leaders Oreb and Zeeb, killing Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb, and brought their heads to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan (Judges 7:24-25). These two place names — the rock of Oreb and the winepress of Zeeb — originated from this event and are referenced again in later Scripture (Psalm 83:11; Isaiah 10:26).
